children: The European Union's natural gas storage currently stands at around 65% of its capacity, Commission spokesperson Anna-Kaisa Itkonen said on Friday.

She added the coordination group set up by the EU to evaluate the natural gas market had met on Thursday and decided to maintain its guidelines to EU countries regarding gas storage ahead of the winter.
